blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around West Central

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC. SnapStats lists "West Central" as a sub-area under the community Maple Ridge.
Boundaries: the City publishes no boundary for the MLS "West Central" sub-area: Not verified as an official boundary.
Nearby areas: Southwest Maple Ridge (Hammond / Port Hammond) to the southwest, East Central and the Town Centre to the east, and Pitt Meadows across the municipal boundary to the west.
Commute times in minutes: Not verified.

Transit: Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Ave) serves the west side and Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) sits at the east edge of the wider west side; West Coast Express trains run weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City. Haney Place Exchange is in the Town Centre to the east (routes include the R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791; the R3 runs Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place). Which of those routes run on West Central streets was not re-verified route by route: Not verified.

Services: no City recreation centre and no library branch sits in West Central — Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place, and Maple Ridge Public Library, 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, are both in the Town Centre to the east. A shopping centre physically inside West Central was not confirmed on an official source: Not verified; the nearest centre is the Town Centre, centred on Haney Place Mall, 11900 Haney Place. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in West Central Maple Ridge Guide

items.t: Zoning — City of Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019: the standard house zone is RS-1 (Single Detached Residential), s.605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40%. Any parcel's actual zone: per-parcel, not verified.

LOUGHEED TRANSIT CORRIDOR — adopted Jan 27, 2026 per the City record (correction carried): Bylaw 7781-2021 (third reading + adoption Jan 27, 2026; City news release Feb 4, 2026); the corridor ends at 221 Street. Do not market corridor upside on a designation alone — confirm a corridor lot's Town Centre plan designation with the City before valuing it.

Suites and SSMUH — Maple Ridge: one secondary suite per lot inside the single detached building, maximum 40% of gross floor area, not within the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws.

blocks.text: Good to know about West Central Maple Ridge Guide

items.t: The downtown services sit at the east edge, not inside the scope (read Nov 1, 2026). Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows with 24/7 emergency care.

The escarpment rule is a pre-purchase check, not a permit-week surprise (read Nov 1, 2026). Lots within 300 m of the Fraser River Escarpment crest need a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit, and the policy area's east boundary is 224 Street — directly relevant to the guide's 223 Street feed edge.

Living in West Central Maple Ridge

faq.a: There is no lot product to buy — no named bare-land subdivision, bare-land strata or presale lot offering exists here. What trades is built fee-simple house lots and strata units in existing complexes.
faq.q: Can I buy a bare building lot in West Central?

faq.a: A purchase there is a strata-lot purchase with fees, bylaws and a Form B, not a vacant-land purchase; the title wording "freehold strata" is not confirmed in-entry and the strata plan governs.
faq.q: Are Sherwood Park and Maple Villas land I can buy as lots?

faq.a: The corridor plan is adopted (Jan 27, 2026, Bylaw 7781-2021, ending at 221 St), so its designations are settled policy — but a designation is not a rezoning approval for a specific parcel. Check the parcel's current designation in the City's document before pricing corridor upside into it.
faq.q: Does the Lougheed corridor plan change what my lot is worth?

faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain), and eligible lots may add up to three, four or six SSMUH units — run both paths before listing an older house on a full-size RS-1 lot.
faq.q: Can a house lot carry a suite or more units?

faq.a: No meaningful one: this is an established-residential sub-area — land trades as built RS-1 fee-simple house lots and strata lots under existing complexes, plus corridor-edge holds under the adopted Lougheed plan, not as vacant subdivision lots.
faq.q: Is there a bare-land market in West Central?

faq.a: At the community level — not West Central's figures — the detached median was $1,131,000 and the attached median was $525,000. Land has no SnapStats category.
faq.q: How did West Central sell in September 2026?

faq.a: A designation is not an approval — check the parcel's designation with the City before valuing it as a plain house lot.
faq.q: What plans shape a West Central lot's value?

faq.q: Can I buy an acreage in West Central?

faq.a: On the edges, potentially: no habitable floor space may sit below the 6.7 m flood construction level on floodplain-affected lots, and lots within 300 m of the escarpment crest (east boundary 224 Street) need a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant before a building permit. Which lots are affected is per-parcel: Not verified until title and the City record are read.
faq.q: Is flood or escarpment risk a factor on a West Central lot?

faq.a: Strata on the record read — fees, management and contingency at both — with the title wording "freehold strata" not confirmed in the listings; the Form B and strata plan settle it. No verified fee-simple complex exists in West Central.
faq.q: Are Sherwood Park and Maple Villas strata or fee-simple?

faq.a: Floodplain and escarpment: No habitable floor space below the 6.7 m flood construction level on affected lots, suites prohibited on floodplain properties, and lots within 300 m of the escarpment crest need a geotechnical report on a Section 219 covenant before a building permit. Parcel-level status is not verified in general here.
faq.q: What edge checks matter on the south and east sides?

faq.a: It can on the corridor edges. The adopted Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan directs growth around future Bus Rapid Transit stations along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, so a corridor lot's plan designation should be checked before it is valued as a plain house lot.
faq.q: Does the Lougheed corridor plan change what my lot can become?

faq.a: No. No City recreation centre is located in West Central — the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre at 11925 Haney Place is in the Town Centre to the east — and the Maple Ridge Public Library at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road is also in the Town Centre.
